prompt: You have $\$20$ saved and earn $\$8$ each week. Solve $8w + 20 = 68$ to find how many weeks until you can buy the $\$68$ sneakers.
hint: Two things were done to $w$: it was multiplied by $8$, then $20$ was added. Undo the last one first.

hints.text: Two things were done to $w$: it was multiplied by $8$, then $20$ was added. Undo the last one first.
Subtract $20$ from both sides to get $8w = 48$. Then divide both sides by $8$.
$48 \div 8 = 6$, so it takes $6$ weeks to afford the sneakers.

explanation: Undo the addition first by subtracting $20$ from both sides, which leaves $8w = 48$.
Now undo the multiplication by dividing both sides by $8$, which gives $w = 6$.
Check: $8(6) + 20 = 48 + 20 = 68$, so you can buy the sneakers after $6$ weeks.

alternativeExplanations.title: As a balance scale
steps: Both sides weigh the same. Take 20 off each pan: $8w$ balances $48$.
Split each pan into 8 equal groups: one $w$ balances $6$.
